title: About
description: Darren McLoughlin is an Irish photographer and photography tour guide behind Panoramic Ireland, offering private photography tours and workshops across Ireland.
html:
Meet Darren McLoughlin

Irish Photographer & Photography Tour Guide

Welcome to Panoramic Ireland. This is me, I'm Darren, an Irish photographer passionate about sharing the breathtaking beauty of Ireland with visitors from around the world.

My Story

For nearly two decades, I've had the privilege of guiding photographers and travellers through Ireland's most spectacular landscapes. What began as architectural photography across Ireland evolved into something much more meaningful – combining my love for this country with my passion for teaching photography.

My background is a bit different from most photographers. Before picking up a camera professionally, I earned a BSc in Geography and worked in Irish archaeology—surveying sites, understanding land formation, and learning how people shaped this landscape over millennia. When I moved into professional photography in the mid-2000s, starting with architectural work, I realised I could combine that technical knowledge with on-site instruction to create photo tours that go deeper than the standard locations and offer authentic Irish experiences.

In 2019, I was diagnosed with cancer. Since making a full recovery, I've returned to work with a sharper focus and a practical appreciation for being out in the elements sharing my knowledge of Ireland with others.

Photo: Clara Borzi

Leading a photography workshop in the Irish countryside

Beyond Landscapes

When I'm not photographing Ireland's scenery I'm usually in a photo pit capturing the energy of live music performances. I've photographed major festivals such as Electric Picnic since 2014 and artists ranging from Judas Priest, Iron Maiden, Anthrax, Marillion, Duran Duran and Ghost as well as solo artists such as Billie Eilish, Dua Lipa, Hozier, Florence + The Machine to name but a few for various publications. Here I am on the left with Alex Skolnick ahead of photographing Testament's gig in Dublin, 2025.

Recognition & Experience

My work has been featured in publications including the New York Times, Guardian, Irish Times, and The Times. I've been trusted by clients ranging from the Ritz-Carlton and Dublin City Council to easyJet and the Irish Landmark Trust.

Published in: New York Times, The Guardian, The Irish Times, The Times
Notable clients: Ritz-Carlton, Dublin City Council, Irish Landmark Trust, easyJet and many small businesses in Ireland

What I Offer

I don't just take you to the tourist spots. I use my knowledge of Ireland's geography, weather patterns, and light to position you for the best shot—whether you're shooting on an iPhone or a Hasselblad. And I'll explain why we're shooting from a particular angle or at a particular time of day, so you leave with knowledge, as well as photos.

Whether you're drawn to Dublin's urban energy, the dramatic Antrim Coast, the wild beauty of Connemara, or hidden corners of the Emerald Isle you've yet to discover, I'm here to guide you. My tours combine:

Insider knowledge of photogenic locations

  • ✓ Professional photography instruction tailored to your skill level from iPhones to Hasselblads
  • ✓ Insider knowledge of Ireland's most photogenic locations
  • ✓ Cultural insights from someone who truly knows this land
  • ✓ Small group and private, individual experiences that feel personal and authentic

Let's Explore Ireland Together

This website represents years of capturing Ireland's essence – from sweeping landscapes to intimate moments. Browse through my favorite Irish locations, learn about photography techniques, or simply get inspired for your own Irish adventure.

Have questions about Ireland or photography? I'm always happy to help you plan the perfect Irish photography experience.

Ready to discover Ireland through your lens? Let's make it happen.
